name: Santa Pola (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Santa Pola (a crowned shield with the Senyera, an anchor and a tower over waves).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Pola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Pola arms — Senyera, anchor and tower
